name: prompt-scheduler
description: Schedule Claude Code prompts for any time (@17:00, @2h30m, @done, @reset), list and cancel them per session, and resume by itself after a usage limit.

schedulerResumeText.title: Resume prompt
schedulerResumeText.description: Prompt sent when a usage-limit wait is over.
schedulerResumeText.default: The usage limit has reset. Carry on with the task you were working on when the limit stopped you. If it was already finished, say so in one line.

schedulerGraceSeconds.title: Grace after reset (s)
schedulerGraceSeconds.description: Extra seconds after the limit resets before resuming (0-900). Claude Code resumes by itself; this backup only sends if the native resume did not act.

schedulerRetryOverloaded.title: Retry overloaded/server errors
schedulerRetryOverloaded.description: Also resume after an overloaded or server error, backing off from one minute.

schedulerMaxRetries.title: Most retries in a row
schedulerMaxRetries.description: Give up after this many resumes without a successful answer (1-20).

schedulerCatchUpMinutes.title: Catch-up window (min)
schedulerCatchUpMinutes.description: A scheduled prompt found overdue (app was closed, laptop asleep) is still sent if it is at most this many minutes late; later than that it expires (0-1440).

schedulerPollSeconds.title: Safety poll every (s)
schedulerPollSeconds.description: How often the queue is checked as a safety net (5-60). Exact firing is done by one timer per prompt; the poll catches whatever a suspended laptop missed.

schedulerHoldDuringLimit.title: Hold prompts during a usage limit
schedulerHoldDuringLimit.description: A scheduled prompt that falls due while a usage limit is active waits for the reset instead of being sent into a refusal.
